arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. One transparent cartoon sprite of a gull with a book, GJGULL1A.BMP 034. Image 1 is the exact original geometry and action authority. Do not invent extra wings, legs, books, text, scenery or shadows. Preserve the bird's pose rather than using a generic standing bird. All inter-part gaps and background must be truly transparent alpha, no matte, glow, floor, checkerboard or decoration. Keep the whole sprite visible with about 5% clear margin.
